Example worflow for lab 9  


```{r}
#| message: false

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(flextable)

stats <- read_csv("~/Downloads/Data Export Summary.csv")

stats |> 
  select(-Other, -Neutron) |> 
  flextable()
```

> Q1: What percentage of structures in the PDB are solved by X-Ray and Electron Microscopy.

```{r}
sum(stats$`X-ray`) / sum(stats$Total)
```

and for EM

```{r}
sum(stats$EM) / sum(stats$Total)
```

> Q2: What proportion of structures in the PDB are protein?

```{r}
# Just Protein
stats$Total[1] / sum(stats$Total)
```

```{r}

inds <- grep("protein", stats$`Molecular Type`, ignore.case = T)
sum(stats[inds,"Total"]) / sum(stats$Total)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

stats |> 
  filter( str_detect(`Molecular Type`, "Protein") ) |>
  select(Total)
```

```{r}
# returns a logical vector
grepl("Protein", stats$`Molecular Type`)
```

```{r}
stats |> 
  filter( grepl("Protein", stats$`Molecular Type`) ) |>
  select(Total)
```


## Some bio3d work

```{r}
library(bio3d)
library(bio3dview)

pdb <- read.pdb("1hsg")
```

```{r}
v <- view.pdb(pdb)

if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
  v
} else {
  f <- view2png(v, autocrop=T)
  knitr::include_graphics(f) 
}

```

```{r}
sel <- atom.select(pdb, resno=25)

view.pdb(pdb, 
         highlight = sel, highlight.style = "spacefill",
         colorScheme = "chain", 
         cols=c("orange","red"), 
         backgroundColor = "pink")
```

```{r}
pdb |> 
  trim.pdb(chain="A")
```

```{r}
pdb |> 
  trim.pdb(chain="A") |>
  pdbseq() -> chainA_seq
```

```{r, blast_search, cache=TRUE}
blast <- blast.pdb(chainA_seq)

head(blast$hit.tbl)
```

```{r}
blast$hit.tbl |>
  select(subjectids, identity, alignmentlength, mlog.evalue) |>
  head(10)
```
```{r}
hits <- plot(blast)
```

```{r}
library(pheatmap)
pheatmap( dist( blast$hit.tbl$mlog.evalue ) )
```

```{r}
aa <- get.seq("1ake_A")
```

```{r, blast_search2, cache=TRUE}
b <- blast.pdb(aa)
hits <- plot(b)
```

```{r, download_pdbs, cache=TRUE}
# Download releated PDB files
files <- get.pdb(hits$pdb.id, path="pdbs", split=TRUE, gzip=TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Align releated PDBs
pdbs <- pdbaln(files, fit = TRUE, exefile="msa")
```

```{r}
pdbs
```

```{r}
pc.xray <- pca(pdbs)
```

```{r}
plot(pc.xray)
```


```{r}
# Calculate RMSD
rd <- rmsd(pdbs)

# Structure-based clustering
hc.rd <- hclust(dist(rd))
grps.rd <- cutree(hc.rd, k=3)

plot(pc.xray, 1:2, col="grey50", bg=grps.rd, pch=21, cex=1)
```


```{r}
pc1 <- mktrj(pc.xray, pc=1, file="pc_1.pdb")
```

```{r}
#Plotting results with ggplot2
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

ids <- sub(".pdb", "", basename(pdbs$id))

df <- data.frame(PC1=pc.xray$z[,1], 
                 PC2=pc.xray$z[,2], 
                 col=as.factor(grps.rd),
                 ids=ids)

p <- ggplot(df) + 
  aes(PC1, PC2, col=col, label=ids) +
  geom_point(size=2) +
  geom_text_repel(max.overlaps = 20) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
p
```

```{r}
view.pca(pc.xray)
```
